subject: world_language
concept: Unit review and mastery check for authentic reading, style/tone analysis, nuanced vocabulary, humor/allusion, creative writing, discussion, and analytical essay writing, confirming CEFR C1 threshold, and full Grade 9 World Languages year-end review
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Mixed set of authentic reading and style/tone questions spanning nodes 01-07
exercise.abstract: Mixed vocabulary, humor/allusion, creative writing, discussion, and essay questions spanning nodes 01-07

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed question types, plus a passing essay and discussion sample
misconception_flags: any single-node misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
next_node_on_fail: WORLDLANG.G9.LITERATURE_MASTERY.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
